tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
One week ago, you ordered a product from a company's website as a Christmas gift. The money has been debited from your account, and the expected delivery time was five days. However, you have not received your order yet.
Write an email to the company's customer service:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: State the issue clearly (order not received despite payment and expected delivery time).
Request an explanation for the delay.
Ask for a solution (e.g., tracking information, refund, or reshipment).
tasks.subject: complaint
tasks.sample:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to follow up on an order I placed on your website one week ago (Order #12345, placed on [date]). The product was intended as a Christmas gift, and the expected delivery time was five days. While the payment has already been debited from my account, I have yet to receive the order or any shipping confirmation.

Could you please provide an update on the status of my order? I would appreciate an explanation for the delay, as well as information about when I can expect delivery. If there are any issues, I would like to explore possible solutions, such as tracking details, a reshipment, or a refund if necessary.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Contact Information]
[Order Number: #12345]
tasks.title: Write an Email
